request.purpose: Recheck SMFA Cup and Shield final Results and Match Report fixture IDs
request.sql: SELECT 'smfacup' competition,r.sm_fixture_id result_fixture,m.sm_fixture_id report_fixture,r.competition_key result_key,m.competition_key report_key,r.match_date result_date,m.match_date report_date,r.home_name result_home,m.home_name report_home,r.away_name result_away,m.away_name report_away,r.home_score result_home_score,m.home_score report_home_score,r.away_score result_away_score,m.away_score report_away_score FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id WHERE r.sm_fixture_id=368667458 UNION ALL SELECT 'smfashield',r.sm_fixture_id,m.sm_fixture_id,r.competition_key,m.competition_key,r.match_date,m.match_date,r.home_name,m.home_name,r.away_name,m.away_name,r.home_score,m.home_score,r.away_score,m.away_score FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id WHERE r.sm_fixture_id=368667459
